title: Shrimp and Crumbly Moroccan Crust Pizza
description: A unique Italian-inspired pizza topped with succulent shrimp and a crumbly Moroccan crust. This dish combines the flavors of Italy with the exotic spices of North Africa.
instructions: Roll out the crumbly dough to a thickness of 1/4 inch.
Transfer the dough to a baking sheet or pizza stone.
Spread a thin layer of tomato sauce over the dough, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Sprinkle the nutty crumble over the sauce.
Add the shrimp on top of the crumble, leaving a little space between each shrimp.
Sprinkle the Moroccan spice over the shrimp.
Bake the pizza in the preheated oven for 15-20 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown and the shrimp are pink.
Remove the pizza from the oven and sprinkle with crumble.
Let the pizza cool for a few minutes before slicing and serving.
